set.body: Deferred by owner decisions recorded 2026-09-17/18 and docs/EXECUTION_RESPONSIVENESS.md. Reopen implementation scheduling only when a consumer requires grids beyond the measured 256x256 / sigma up to 32 cells envelope or supported-runtime measurements invalidate that envelope. Current implementation estimates one trial per step. Scope on activation: bounded pure yields inside the convolution passes and normalization of one trial, plus any measured setup work needed to meet the bound; do not automatically refactor all occupancy/kernel/allocation paths. Preserve accumulation order, standard-deviation bandwidth, edge policy, mass, provenance, Agreement and typed failures. Acceptance: drain budgets 1, small primes and larger-than-work with identical designated outputs; independent direct-sum non-square centre/edge/corner oracle under both edge policies with named tolerance; work accounting and cancellation/disposal without exposing partial Mass; explicit larger-grid workload and pinned-runtime 100 ms response target. JVM/JS and effect boundaries remain binding. No current consumer trigger has been recorded.
